content:
Refund tax should use **`decimal.ROUND_DOWN`**, based on what finance told you this morning. Invoice tax doesn't change and still uses banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), which finance agreed on in March 2026.

The code doesn't calculate or round refund tax anywhere yet. `src/billing/refunds.py` only checks the refund amount and returns cents. So nothing in the code conflicts with the new rule, but whoever adds refund tax will need to use `ROUND_DOWN` on purpose rather than copying the invoice-tax rounding.

I also updated the project memory. The old note said "Tax uses ROUND_HALF_EVEN" for all tax. It now applies only to invoice tax and mentions the refund exception. I added a separate note saying refund tax uses `ROUND_DOWN`, dated 2026-10-02.
